name: deepseek-worker
description: Let Claude hand off well-specified coding and web research to DeepSeek as a cheap worker, with token and balance usage in the status line.

api_key.title: DeepSeek API key
api_key.description: Stored in secure storage. Leave empty to use ~/.config/deepseek/api_key (readable only by you). Environment variables are not read.

allow_outside_workdir.title: Skip the file permission check
allow_outside_workdir.description: Off by default: `files` and `output_path` may only use paths Claude Code lets Claude Read / Write (working folder, scratchpad, /add-dir folders), and never files a deny rule blocks.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the status line and /deepseek-usage: auto (your system language, English if it can't be told), en or ko. Prompts and tool text the model reads are always English.
